# يَتَدَرْبَسُ (yatadarbasu) /ja.ta.dar.ba.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَدَرْبَسَ (tadarbasa)
# يُتَدَرْبَسُ (yutadarbasu) /ju.ta.dar.ba.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَدَرْبَسَ (tadarbasa)
# يَتَدَرْبَسَ (yatadarbasa) /ja.ta.dar.ba.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَدَ
